record.paper_title: Open Problems and Conjectures Related to the Theory of Mathematical Quasicrystals
record.original_question: Find a set of local matching rules for tilings in dimension 2 or 3 such that both of the following hold: (A) for each tile type t there is a constant c_t with discrepancy D_t(R)=|N_t(R)-d(t)·vol(R)| bounded by c_t·|∂R| for every finite union R of tiles, and (B) the same low-fluctuation bound also holds for every pattern or patch satisfying the matching rules.

evidence.quote: (A) ... there exists a constant ct depending only on the tile t such that Dt(R) ≤ ct · |∂R| ... (B) The second condition is that property (A) should also hold for any pattern or patch satisfying the given matching rule. Problem 2.7.3 Find a set of matching rules in dimension 2 and/or 3 that meet both condition (A) and condition (B).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Consider tilings of $\mathbb{R}^d$ (with $d=2$ or $d=3$) by finitely many translation classes of tiles, where each tile is a compact polytope. A set of local matching rules is a finite collection of allowed local configurations (patches up to translation within some bounded radius) which determines a tiling space $X$ consisting of all tilings of $\mathbb{R}^d$ in which every local configuration belongs to the allowed list.

For a tiling $T \in X$ and each tile type $t$, let $N_t(R)$ denote the number of tiles of type $t$ of $T$ that are contained in a bounded measurable region $R \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ (taken to be a finite union of tiles of $T$), and let $d(t)$ denote the asymptotic frequency (density) per unit volume of tiles of type $t$ in $T$. Define the discrepancy
$$D_t(R) = \bigl| N_t(R) - d(t)\,\mathrm{vol}(R) \bigr|.$$
Let $|\partial R|$ denote the $(d-1)$-dimensional Hausdorff measure of the boundary of $R$.

Problem. Exhibit, in dimension $d=2$ or $d=3$, a set of local matching rules with the following two properties simultaneously:

(A) There exists a particular tiling $T_0 \in X$ such that for every tile type $t$ there is a constant $c_t > 0$ (depending only on $t$) with
$$D_t(R) \le c_t \, |\partial R|$$
for every region $R$ that is a finite union of tiles of $T_0$.

(B) The same bound holds with the same constants $c_t$ uniformly for every tiling $T \in X$ satisfying the matching rules and every region $R$ that is a finite union of tiles of $T$.

Construct such a set of matching rules, or prove that none exists.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears in a survey of open problems on mathematical quasicrystals. Weak matching rules are known to enforce bounded perp-space fluctuations for many cases (e.g., N-fold symmetric tilings with N not divisible by 4, and icosahedral cases), but no construction is documented that simultaneously achieves the strong boundary-proportional discrepancy bound (A) and that this bound holds uniformly for every patch satisfying the rules (B) in dimensions 2 or 3. No resolution was found in the search; status appears open.

status_evidence.title: Weak matching rules for quasicrystals
status_evidence.snippet: Weak matching rules for a quasicrystalline tiling are local rules that ensure that fluctuations in perp-space are uniformly bounded. Weak matching rules exist for N-fold symmetric tilings, where N is any integer not divisible by four.
status_evidence.claim: Weak matching rules give bounded perp-space fluctuations but do not directly establish boundary-proportional tile-count discrepancy uniformly across all patches.

status_evidence.title: Bounded displacement non-equivalence in substitution tilings
status_evidence.snippet: Research on bounded displacement (BD) equivalence and non-equivalence of Delone sets associated to tilings.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work studies discrepancy/BD-equivalence in substitution tilings; no construction of matching rules satisfying both (A) and (B) is reported.
